# Invented course data for the course tests

Everything here is made up (paper planes and kites). It has the shape of
Groundwork's course data (`groundwork/`), so `frontdoor/course/build-course-file.ts`
can be tested without the real curriculum, which never goes in this repo.
The `SECRET` strings stand for key point statements and source passages:
the tests check that none of them reaches the course file.
